title: World Lore - The Pitt
sub: Notes, holotapes and terminals no quest owns, found in The Pitt, grouped by place.

items.name: Bad Omens
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Things remain peaceful here, while the chasm surrounding the cathedral grows wider and deeper. Supply runs are becoming more and more dangerous.

An illness is going around. If it weren't for the air it wouldn't be so bad. Olivia almost stopped breathing last night.

It was just after I saw a shadow outside the window. It looked like a person. Maybe it was nothing. We can't afford to have the Fanatics find us now.

I pray our safe haven remains as such, for as long as the Lord will grant us mercy.

items.name: Dominance
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Remember, assert your dominance. They scream at you, you scream back, louder.

If that doesn't work give 'em a solid crack to the skull. That'll send 'em crawling back into their holes.

Works every time on the little bastards. It's the big bastards you need to watch out for.

You see one of those and you'd better find a turret to hide behind real quick.

items.name: Few More Days
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Just a few more days. At least that's what I keep telling myself. These guys may be crazy but what other options do I have?

All I gotta do is keep my head down and do what they say. The sooner the others realize that the sooner they'll be up here too.

I'm worried about my cell mates. They seem excited about joining. Who would actually want to treat other living beings like this?

Just a few more days, then maybe I'll be able to help the others.

items.name: Goodbye Cliffy
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Tonight we're gathered here to say goodbye to ol' Cliffy.
You tried to get away and that just broke our hearts.
(Sad Face)
Nearly got away too, didn't you?
(Emphasis on Nearly)
That's ok, you're back with us now!
(Happy Face)
I'd ask if you have any last words but I doubt you can speak with your jaw looking like that.
(Pause for reaction.)
Anyway, goodbye Cliffy.
(Remember to flip switch.)

items.contents:
Think I'm losing it down here.

Maybe it's just my imagination but I could have sworn I heard one of those little bastards say my name.

That can't be, they're just god damn monsters.

Now that I think about it, it did kind of look like my old bunkmate. Fucked up face and everything.

items.name: Memo to Team
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Team,

As you may know, donations have been down across the board. We're going to try something different this month by instituting quotas.

Each of you will now be responsible for soliciting at least $155,000 for the month of October.

In the event you are unable to meet your quota for the month you will be asked to volunteer elsewhere.

Thank you for your understanding, and remember, top contributor will receive a $300 gift card to Slocum's Joe!

-Management

items.contents:
At night the fanatics retreat to the cathedral, that's when the beasts come out.

I think the beasts have started to learn they can't get into our cells and have mostly given up trying.

Or maybe they feel bad for us. It's almost peaceful now.

items.name: No Escape
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Lost Matt last night... I told him not to go, he insisted he'd be fine since the beasts have begun to leave us alone.

He didn't make it far before we heard a bear trap catch his leg. His screams brought every one of the beasts down onto him. At least it was over quick.

Is this why the guards stopped locking our cells?

items.name: Priest's Letter
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Brother Sherman,

I hope this letter finds you well. However I am in dire need of your help. I should have known better than to do business with those goons.

The church needed money and they offered a way out. Said they'd leave us more than enough to keep the doors open. But now they're leaving us with nothing.

I pleaded with their boss but he laughed and said I should start offering tours of those "spooky catacombs" of ours. Have they no respect for the dead?

Please I need your advice. I didn't join the priesthood for money, I just wanted to spread the good word.

Regards,
Brother Michael

items.name: Runner's Log 03: Too Much
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I'm Bella Gerber, a Runner for the Union. Or at least I used to be. To tell you the truth, I think we're alone out here.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Haven't heard from headquarters in months, and they haven't heard from us.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: The Union... we're all trying our best to help everyone, but there's just too many people to help, too much to do, too many hazards in the way.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: We're running low on supplies. I spend every daylight hour scavenging, but it's not enough. I need help. And we're not getting any.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Some of the survivors volunteered to go out scavenging with me. Young ones. The last partner I had out here was boiled alive in a radpit.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: If even he couldn't... (deep breath) I can't let them risk their lives, not after I promised them safety.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I'm gonna start going out at night too. Maybe then I can gather enough.

items.name: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: This is Bella Gerber. Used to be a Union Runner. Now I'm a prisoner.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: The Fanatics found us. They took over the Sanctum. Everyone I promised safety... I delivered them straight into the hands of the Fanatics.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I was so arrogant. So stupid. Forgot that I wasn't the only person capable of navigating the Trench, of learning how to navigate it.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Pat always told me I needed to learn to trust others, to stop taking the weight of the world upon myself. (sad laugh) But he's the same way.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I hadn't mentioned it before, but I... I have a husband. Pat Gerber. We promised to meet up after our work for the Union was done.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: But it will never be done, will it, Pat? Things will only get worse and worse.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I don't think I'll make it out of here. But I could at least give the others a chance.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: The others I condemned, bringing them here with the promise of safety. I have to give them a chance, Pat.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: This will be my final log. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: And Pat, if you ever find that monster you were looking for... Don't go alone.

items.name: Sealed Away
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
How long have we been down here? Weeks? Months? At this point I can't really tell who's worse, those fanatics or the beasts.
At least it's not personal with the beasts. You don't see them sealing each other up in walls.

items.name: Test Results
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Fridge - 2 hours. Guess these are more air tight than I thought.

Coffin - 6 hours. One pipe, insufficient? Maybe another hole on the bottom to promote air flow?

Bathtub - 8 days. Think we got a winner here.

The smell of damp laborer may be a bit much at times but it gives them ample time to reconsider our offer.

items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
To the Foreman:

Mia got dragged away last night. I barely managed to shut the gate before she dragged me away with her.

With all due respect, we need more security down here. We're just as vulnerable to the trogs as the prisoners are! The last three people who got assigned with me didn't survive the night.

Ah shit. You're trying to get rid of me, aren't you?

items.name: Chemist's Orders
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents: The boss wants us mixing day and night, no rest. We'll turn those Union rabbits into paste with the weapons we make here, and if that's not reward enough, the bonus is two servants from the pens -- your pick. As for the kill counts, you'll get credit for every bunny our soldiers poach with your weapon. That's the sweetest deal in the Pitt, so make sure you mix your chems right. One wrong dose and the whole operation goes up in toxic, choking smoke. And you with it.

items.name: Fanatic Manhunter's Note
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
The last hunt was an eventful one. We bagged two high profile targets, a number of captives, and some loot they were hauling. Looks like food rations... Certainly a blow to the enemy. Not only will they starve, but we will eat. Much better than just burning the warehouse. We should target this supply route more in the future to put a quicker end to this war.

This haul belongs to the Manhunters by right of conquest. We've stored it in the old slag separation room until we can move it out to headquarters. The others know who it belongs to, they won't dare touch it until we return.

items.name: Hellcat Contract
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
The undersigned agree that for a term of eighteen (18) months PARTY A is contracted to the HELLCAT MERCENARY COMPANY (hereafter referred to as "PARTY B") in the role of PRIVATE.

PARTY A acknowledges that this contract obliges them to use force for the interests of PARTY B. PARTY A acknowledges that this contract binds them to the orders of their superior officers, and that any concerns regarding orders must be raised through the agreed upon process as presented in document 3-C.

In exchange for services rendered, PARTY B agrees to provide food, shelter, and payment in caps to PARTY A for the length of the contract. PARTY B acknowledges that failure to provide these benefits for a period of one (1) or more weeks entitles PARTY A to terminate the contract.

PARTY A acknowledges that desertion and/or abandonment of contract will result in a complete ban from future work with PARTY B. Furthermore, PARTY B reserves the right to enforce the terms of the contract by whatever means it deems justified.

Finally, PARTY A acknowledges that this contract obliges them to undertake acts of great personal risk on behalf of PARTY B -- potentially resulting in serious injury or death -- for the term of this contract.

items.name: New Shipment: Heads Up
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Got another shipment in along the old railway trail. Ammo mostly, but also something special: a Union supply crate. Orders are to dole it out all even like, but seeing as how only you and I know about it... well, let's just say there's a lot in it for you, for a price.

Meet me in the shipping warehouse and we'll discuss it. And none of that attack bot bullshit like last time. I'll be ready.

items.name: Scavenger's Journal
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Diary dearest,

Roaming the streets of Pittsburgh on yesterday eve was I, quite enjoying the calming crackle of gunfire (pop, pop-pop-pop) when lo did I behold a sight so unexpected that it startled me more than a Union ambush! In the darkest corner of the backest alleyway did I spy a large crate of enemy rations, wholly unguarded among the half-eaten corpses of our foe!
[pagebreak]
"Surely a trap," I pondered to myself, yet cautiously I approached. I could not let this opportunity escape! After much prodding from afar I determined that this boon was unlikely to explode upon immediate contact. Nor did mine senses detect the slightest hint of an ambush lying in wait.
[pagebreak]
I alighted with my prize, back to the Foundry from whence I came. But a cloud still hangs above mine head. Forsooth, perhaps this eminent stash only spells disaster when it is opened? The thought gnaws at me. I cannot risk disaster at so late a stage!

I have hidden yonder cache away among the blast furnaces, where it will be safe from prying eyes until I can determine a method of attack.

items.name: Union Missive
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
WHY WE FIGHT

When you feel that the walls are closing in around you, remember WHY WE FIGHT. Look to the left and right at your fellow human being, working in unison to achieve our goal of a peaceful tomorrow for Pittsburgh. Look out the window at the chaos below. We can push back the forces of evil, clean up our city, and restore order, but we need YOU to do it!

Remember the children, hoping for a better world to grow up in. Remember our friends who have lost their freedom to the dominant forces of evil. Remember the dead, who gave their lives so that we could emerge victorious!

The deck has always been stacked against us, but we never go down without a fight! So keep your chin up and soldier on to a BETTER PITTSBURGH!

items.name: Warden's Note
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents: Sixteen in and ten out in the last five days. I know we're not the Sanctum, but this pace won't cut it. Weapons testing is taking its toll. Too many casualties, too much wasted labor. There just aren't enough captives to go around in this part of town to be wasting them on some "new weapon" when we can just kill Union the old fashioned way. We'll never meet our quota this way, it's a disaster. I'll need to transfer out of labor at this rate, or I'll be the next one in the pens.

items.name: A Farewell to Pittsburgh
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Last chronicle of Sgt. Ning, Hellcat Company -- or what's left of it, anyway.

We've spent a long time in the Pitt. The wars among its occupants have been incessant, but all that is finally drawing to a close. Not much left in the way of resistance, anymore. The Fanatics own damn near everything. Only the Union remains... Until this monolith falls apart and it starts all over again.

We made the right choice becoming mercenaries, I still believe that. Fought on every which side and made a killing doing it. We came out on top, and now we should get the hell out before the Fanatics turn on us, too.

Some of the others may have doubts, given the casualties we've sustained, and I get that. Has to be that half of us are gone now, from when I started. Maybe more, hard to keep count. But that's behind us now. I have no interest in sticking around to find out what "peace time" means for these raiders. I'm moving on to greener pastures.

This world needs its killers, or its defenders, or whatever you'll pay me to be. Have to be other towns out there just as fucked as we were by the war and the bombs and everything that goes with it. I hear Kit's taking some of the others and heading south, but that sounds weak... Appalachia is soft, no bombs there, no challenge.

No, I'll go elsewhere. See what trouble I can get into. Gets my blood pumping just thinking about it.

items.name: Getting Through
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
I think our weekly game night is really helping me reach her. I told her that it doesn't matter what you've done.
The only thing that matters now is what you're going to do. These "Union Pricks" will still take you in.
Last week I reminded her of that bind I got her out of in Oakmont. Then when I told her what her new friends were doing to our people in Sanctum I saw her eyes well up ever so slightly.
I'll get through to her. We've known each other since we were children, for heaven's sake.

items.name: Time Enough At Last
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Everyone was gone in a flash, just like that.  All my family and neighbors. If it just, wasn't for the loneliness.

At least I have my books. The collective works of Venable, Brahm, Sterling, and Meredith.

Books! Books, all the books I'll ever need, ever want! And the best thing of all is there's time, all the time I need and all the time I want.

There's time enough at last.

items.name: Warning Shots
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Listen, I know Evan told us to only fire warning shots if you see any of those Fanatic assholes rummaging around.
But I'm telling you, if you see one, you put a shot right between their sub-human eyes. We both know they wouldn't afford us the courtesy of a "warning shot".
Besides, as far as I can tell they aren't going anywhere any time soon. The fewer of them around the better our chances are.

items.name: Wishlist
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Look we know it's slim pickins out there but we really need antibiotics and disinfectant.
We need to secure as much as we can before the Fanatics get their hands on what little is left.
Those halfwits almost certainly don't know you can't get high off of antibiotics...
Keep and eye out for screws and duct tape as well.
What do you think is holding this place together? Prayers and well-wishing?

items.name: Ava's Journal #1
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Once more I've been led to salvation.

So many I had to leave behind. So many innocent lives laid to waste by the misguided. This city crumbles all around me. Yet it is still my home.

And the people left behind are my neighbors. I will stay, and guide whom I can to the same salvation I was granted.

I pray for the strength I need to guide them. If I cannot find it within my own aging body, let me work through my words, through my hope. There are those I may still influence. I pray they are sent along my path.

items.name: Ava's Journal #2
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
These lost lambs have answered my prayers. A feral child, born in the chasm. A chemist from the factory, driven close to madness after the earth opened up and spilled her own creation upon her. A runaway Fanatic in repentance.

The child and chemist, I offered each of them to share my shelter. On the first day, they wouldn't approach each other. I was surprised on the second day to find them sharing the food they had each scavenged. On day three, they were gone. Two souls who each believed themselves monsters, yet they found humanity in each other.

The Fanatic: he lingers. Always just out of eyesight, taking only what he needs. But among needs, there is more than just the physical. With time, maybe I can teach him.

items.name: Ava's Journal #3
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
The runaway tracker - for it is no longer right to define him by his past - he lingers still, away from the light. He accepts my gifts now. I can only hope that it means his heart is opening.

He seeks purpose. A new role in this desolate city. But he does not believe himself worthy.

Even if he cannot find it in himself to forgive his past mistakes, he must give himself permission to take a step forward. One step, and then another. Each day brings new light, new challenges, new opportunities. Perhaps one day he will look back and find his past self is but a distant shadow. A healed scar on the inevitable horizon.

items.name: Concerned Employee
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
31148 chews through these cheap plastic barrels like a kid at a candy store. This is going to become a huge problem when you consider that failed batches like 31148-042 react exponentially more violent than successful batches.

If one of these barrels leaks a failed batch and a reaction is triggered, you are talking about shutting down an entire city block for weeks to clean up the fallout. Surely an outcome like that is worth avoiding by just paying for the dam metal barrels?

A concerned employee

items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Abraxodyne Chemical Complex, PGH

MEMO REGARDING OFFICE PRANKS
---------------------

At Abraxodyne Chemical, we prioritize a safe and productive working environment. While we all enjoy some lighthearted fun in the office, it is important to remind everyone that we are a chemical company, and safety is paramount.

In light of an incident yesterday regarding the improper usage of PID 31162 sample for a "prank", we feel it important to remind everyone of how we expect employees to behave while on the clock. Rest assured, those responsible have already been appropriately reprimanded.

Attached is an updated copy of the employee code of conduct. Study it and be ready to take a test on the material tomorrow.

There is a "Get Well" card, and a jar to raise money for a wig for Margaret over at Sydney's desk. Consider signing it on your way out and throwing some change in the jar if the spirit moves you.

items.contents:

If you can make it through the Trench, safe haven can be found at the Sanctum. Look for the cathedral. This is one of the few places we're still safe from the Fanatics.

Ella

items.name: The Hellcats' New Assignment
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Survival comes first, and mercenary work is a great way to stay off the losing side. But that's not gonna stop me from complaining about how these Fanatics do things.

They hired us on a few weeks ago. Seems they needed some extra guns to finish securing their hold on the Pitt. But this just looks like chaos and tyranny more than any type of control. They have us storm into Union bases, kill everyone in sight, and then move on to the next without so much as stopping to loot the wreckage. Last time, one of those assholes accidentally shot Hoffman in the leg during the assault. Couldn't tell friend from foe.

There's been talk of leaving this place after our stint with the Fanatics is done, finding work somewhere we could actually sleep at night. It wouldn't be a bad call.

But me? I prefer a known enemy, and I've known the Pitt all my life.

-A. Rhoades, Hellcat Mercenary Company

items.name: Waste Storage Memo
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Abraxodyne Chemical Complex, PGH

REVISION TO WASTE STORAGE POLICY
---------------------

Due to financial circumstances out of our control, metal waste barrels will be unavailable to us going forward. Plastic barrels will be used in the meantime.

In the event of corrosive wastes damaging the integrity of the container, efforts should be taken to reseal the container instead of retrieving a new one. Application of adhesive tape and Wonderglue is the current recommended solution.

Questions or concerns about the new barrels can be left with Sydney, and she will make sure they get to my desk.

Edgar Clemmon
